description: Ministry of Justice and Prison Reforms - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 43/4 (02.07.1979) relating to the High Court of the Republic of Sri Lanka held in the Judicial Zone of Colombo
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an amendment to regulations under the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978. It contains a regulation made by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms regarding changes to the jurisdiction of the High Court, including modifications to prosecutions under the Penal Code and Bribery Act. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with legal amendments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
